vdfm0e15.baseName: COSTWAY 6 FT Pre-lit Artificial Snow-Flocked Christmas Tree-White
vdfm0e15.variantName: COSTWAY 6 FT Pre-lit Artificial Snow-Flocked Christmas Tree-White
vdfm0e15.sourceDescription: This tree features low-shed, firmly bonded flocking for a realistic snow-capped look. Loaded with dense branch tips and lifelike PVC leaves, its layered sprigs form a full, voluminous silhouette. Pre-lit with warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it allows you to switch between lights on for steady welcoming glow and lights off to admire the tree's natural snow-dusted beauty. Built with a section hinged structure and robust metal stand, it unfolds quickly and stores flat; included gloves protect hands during foliage fluffing. Made of 100% new PVC material, it is flame-retardant, anti-fading, allergy-proof and smell-free for safe indoor holiday decoration year after year. Note: Ornaments are not included. Velvety Flocked Charm: Securely bonded to its foliage, the dense flocked layer on this artificial Christmas tree creates a snow-capped aesthetic. Low-shed premium flocking mimics fresh winter snow, pouring dreamy wintry charm into your holiday space. Full-Bodied Appearance: Loaded with dense branch tips and lifelike PVC leaves, this snow-flocked holiday tree features soft frosted detailing across every sprig. Its densely layered branches capture the lush form of a real tree, building a voluminous silhouette for natural festive styling. Soft Warm White Glow: Gentle warm white light spills from LED bulbs woven throughout this pre-lit tree's branches. Powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it maintains this calm, welcoming illumination reliably and safely. Easy Assembly: Built with a section structure, this lush Xmas tree features hinged branches that fan out effortlessly. Its sturdy metal stand enables compact storage, and the included gloves keep hands comfortable while you fluff the foliage. Premium PVC Foliage: Constructed from PVC foliage, this hinged holiday tree comes with flame-retardant, allergy-proof and smell-free features for stress-free holiday decorating. It also resists fading across repeated festive seasons and preserves its charming look year after year. Specifications Color: White Material: PVC, Metal Product Dimensions: 120 x 180 cm(Dia. x H) Tree Height: 183 cm Tree Width: 120 cm Diameter of Stand: 50 cm Number of Branch Tips: 820 Number of LED Lights: 250 Number of Sections: 3 Power Cord Length: 150 cm Net Weight: 8.5 kg Is Assembly Required: Yes Box QTY: 1(May vary by batch) Package Includes: 1 x Christmas Tree 2 x Pairs of Gloves 1 x User Guide Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

qg3pgbdq.variantName: COSTWAY 5FT Artificial Pencil Slim Christmas Tree with Stand - Green
qg3pgbdq.sourceDescription: This is a new Christmas tree. The Christmas Workshop presents this great decorative idea for your home or office. If you always wanted a Christmas tree but don't have the floor space or storage space when not needed, this is the perfect tree for you. Cheap but really beautiful, do not hesitate to take it home! Stable Metal Base: A metal stand is sturdy enough to support the whole fiber optic Christmas tree, and you can put more decorations on the tree while keeping the tree in a stead condition. Besides, there is a plastic cover at the end of this stand to enhance the stability as well as prevent the tree damage to your floor or outer box. Eco-Friendly and Durable Material: The blades of our Christmas tree are made from premium PVC material, which not only makes the tree look more real and more full, but also adds anti-crush capacity to the tree, making it durable for long-time use. Slim and Lush Xmas Tree: If space is limited and you need a great-looking tree our pencill slim pine tree with densely packed and folded branches is your first choice. It requires less space of your room but owns plenty of branches, allowing you can decorate it with more small ornaments. Flexible and Foldable Tree Tips: Each lush artificial Christmas tree in our store owns lots of branches with thick leaves, and you can adjust them flexibly, just DIY the branches according to your own needs to achieve the desired effect. Thick or sparse, it's up to you! And all the branches can be folded for easy storage Set it up in Minutes: To finish the assembly of this Xmas tree just requires 3 steps, after putting branches and metal stand together, all the tree requires you to do is straighten out the branches, so the tree will achieve the best effect. q97bw4qp.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q97bw4qp.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q97bw4qp.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree captures the holiday magic with its vibrant design and season-inspired aesthetic. Perfect for those seeking a modern twist on a traditional favorite, this tree marries simplicity with elegance, fitting seamlessly into any living room, garden, or terrace. The contemporary style—characterized by clean lines and minimal ornamentation—brings a sleek look to any festive setting, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. PVC and Steel Build: Constructed from a blend of PVC and steel, this artificial tree offers a robust structure designed to last season after season. The abrasion-resistant material ensures longevity, while the steel stand provides excellent stability, easy to assemble with just a screwdriver. Energy-Efficient LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights, this tree features energy-saving properties and dynamic lighting patterns. With 8 distinct flash modes, these lights illuminate the tree in intricate patterns, creating vibrant light displays that enhance any holiday décor. Convenient USB Power Source: This tree's innovative USB connectivity offers flexible power options, making it easy to power up without needing a traditional outlet. Simply plug it into a portable power bank or any compatible device, offering hassle-free setup. Stylish Modern Design: The cone-shaped frame and modern design elements make this tree a stylish addition to homes or outdoor spaces with shelter. Its sleek appearance fits smoothly into minimalist or contemporary setups, enhancing the visual appeal of any seasonal scene. Easy Assembly and Care: Designed for ease, assembling this tree is simple. With only a screwdriver and a partner needed, it's ready to impress. Follow care instructions for assembly efficiently, ensuring the tree remains a staple holiday decoration for years. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Purple Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

k0za0ypf.sourceDescription: Adorned with 688 flocked branch tips, it exudes a lush and vibrant charm that will captivate your guests and remind you of a blossoming spring. The Xmas tree comes to life at night with 200 LED lights, casting a warm white glow and creating a romantic ambiance. Crafted from durable PVC and highly simulated PE, this masterpiece is not only resistant to fire and allergies but also completely safe for your family. Setting up is a breeze with its hinged connections, minimizing your efforts and maximizing your joy. Also, we offer a pair of gloves for better protection. Supported by a sturdy folding metal stand secured with strong bolts, this Christmas tree remains stable and can be a realistic decoration for wide use, like home, office, school, or carnival. Its anti-slip foot pads ensure your floors are protected from scratches. Let the enchantment of this tree illuminate your holiday season, which is almost as good as a real tree. Lush Snowy Tree: The Xmas tree will be a perfect addition for the wintry season, as it features 688 flocked branch tips. At the same time, its luxuriant design presents great vibrancy, which will remind people of spring and delight your guests. Premium LED Lights: To attract people at night, the Christmas tree comes with 200 LED lights to provide a warm white lighting show, which will create a loving vibe. Also, LED lights are more durable, energy-saving and much safer for home uses. Selected PE and PVC: Made of long-lasting PVC and PE, the Xmas tree is able to serve for a longer time. Also, it shows ideal resistance to fire and allergies, while having no weird smells. All make it become safer for your family. Hinged Connections: Installation is a breeze, since the Xmas tree has a hinged frame that will automatically expand branch tips to reduce the setup time. Also, we provide you with a pair of gloves to protect your hands when you install 2 sections. Stable for Wide Use: Supported by a folding metal stand with strong bolts included, the Christmas tree offers great stability for applications in the office, school, carnival, etc. More, it has anti-slip foot pads that will protect your floor from being scratched. vhds5107.sourceDescription: Create a warm and festive welcome with these Christmas door garland lights, featuring 800 micro LED lights across a 5.5m illuminated length for a bright, eye-catching seasonal display. With eight lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Chasing/Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash and Steady On, you can customise the lighting to suit your festive décor. The built-in timer provides six hours of illumination followed by an automatic 18-hour off cycle, with simple ON/OFF controls for convenient operation. Mains powered with a 5m lead cable, these lights offer flexible placement around your home. The IP44 weather-resistant rating makes them suitable for indoor and outdoor use, including decorating front doors, garlands, staircases, Christmas trees, fireplaces and banisters. Specifications: 800 micro LED lights, 5.5m illuminated length, eight lighting modes, built-in six-hour timer with an 18-hour off cycle, ON/OFF control, 5m mains power lead, IP44 weather-resistant rating and suitable for indoor and outdoor Christmas decorations. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

mxx623sd.sourceDescription: The tree base cover is designed to fit 6 ft-9 ft/180-270 cm tall Christmas trees and cover stands up to 26”/65.5 cm wide. Please measure your tree stand before purchase. Unlike fabric alternatives, this wooden tree ring resists wrinkles and retains its shape year after year with minimal upkeep. Featuring a convenient slide-up-to-lock mechanism, assembly is quick and effortless, while the collapsible design ensures easy, space-saving storage after the season ends. Showcasing the many tree collar benefits, this collar not only hides the stand to elevate your festive centerpiece but also offers a pet-friendly barrier that keeps pets safe and maintains a tidy, balanced appearance throughout the holidays. Rustic Holiday Charm: Natural wood grain and festive hollowed Christmas patterns turn your tree base into a warm centerpiece. The rustic Christmas tree collar pairs beautifully with farmhouse, traditional, and modern decoration. Size-Friendly Fit: This Xmas tree ring is designed to suit 180-270 cm tall Christmas trees and cover most tree stands up to 65.5 cm. To ensure the best holiday-ready fit, please measure your tree stand before purchase. Natural Paulownia Strength: Crafted from natural paulownia wood, this Christmas tree stand cover is sturdy, enduring, and safe for seasonal use. The strong structure holds its shape season after season, and unlike fabric alternatives, it resists wrinkles and is super easy to maintain. Fast Locking Setup: Slide-up-to-lock connections make assembly simple and satisfying, so you can finish decorating sooner. When the season ends, the collapsible tree collar folds down for compact storage, helping you keep your holiday essentials organized. Cleaner Look, Safer Space: The wooden tree collar neatly hides the tree stand to create visual balance. It also adds pet-friendly safety by creating a cleaner barrier around the base area, helping reduce curiosity around the stand.
